findings.title: immediateDelete path cancels SendGrid but never deletes DB row
findings.body: deleteScheduledEmailReminder with immediateDelete=true POSTs status=cancel to SendGrid and then returns without deleting or updating the WorkflowReminder row. Callers in handleNewBooking reschedule path and workflows delete/step-delete paths rely on this to remove the reminder, so the row stays in the DB with scheduled=true and the same referenceId. For reschedule there is no cascade delete, so orphan scheduled rows accumulate and will later be cleaned only as past-due without ever being cancelled in some paths.

findings.title: Bulk email cancel aborts and skips DB deletes on first failure
findings.body: The cron loops with await client.request inside try, pushes prisma.workflowReminder.delete promises, and only after the loop does Promise.all. If any single SendGrid cancel throws, control jumps to catch, the Promise.all is never reached, so even reminders already cancelled in SendGrid are never deleted from the DB. They will be retried every 15 minutes and re-cancelled, and a single bad batch_id blocks all other cancellations in that run.

findings.title: Unscheduled-reminder query can schedule cancelled reminders
findings.body: unscheduledReminders finds method=EMAIL, scheduled=false, scheduledDate within 72h with no filter on cancelled. Any row with cancelled=true and scheduled=false would still be sent via SendGrid and then marked scheduled=true. The new design keeps cancelled rows in the DB until the cron cancels them, so the schedule path must exclude cancelled=true or a cancelled booking can still get emails.

findings.title: Cancel query not scoped to EMAIL/scheduled reminders with referenceId
findings.body: remindersToCancel selects only cancelled=true and scheduledDate, with no method=EMAIL, scheduled=true, or referenceId not null filter. SMS reminders use Twilio SIDs not SendGrid batch_ids and email rows without referenceId have nothing to cancel in SendGrid. If such a row ever has cancelled=true the job will POST a Twilio SID or null batch_id to /v3/user/scheduled_sends and then delete the row, which is wrong and hides the logic error.

findings.title: Past-due delete runs before cancel and drops cancelled sends
findings.body: The handler first deleteMany all EMAIL reminders with scheduledDate <= now without cancelling them in SendGrid, then queries cancelled reminders within the next hour. Past-due cancelled rows are deleted without ever attempting SendGrid cancel. If the cron was down or missed the 1-hour window, the email may already have been sent, but the ordering guarantees no cancel attempt is made.

findings.title: Workflow reminder cancellations not awaited
findings.body: updatedBookings.forEach calls deleteScheduledEmailReminder and deleteScheduledSMSReminder without await or Promise.all, and the same fire-and-forget forEach pattern is repeated in handleNewBooking, bookings.tsx requestReschedule, and workflows.tsx. The async Prisma update/cancel and external SendGrid/Twilio calls run in background, so the API can return before cancellation is persisted, errors become unhandled rejections only logged inside the helper, and process shutdown loses cancellations.
